## The Alpine Series
The Dolomites are not just mountains; they are sculptures of time. My work focuses on the transition between the sharp, jagged peaks and the soft, rolling mist of the valleys.

---

<!-- columns:2 split="1:1" -->
<!-- col -->
## The Texture of Stone
I believe that every rock face tells a story of erosion and endurance. By using a high-contrast palette, I aim to reveal the microscopic details of the limestone.

- **Focus:** Texture & Contrast
- **Location:** Northern Italy
- **Season:** Late Autumn
